taxonomy_mapping_dispositions.reason: Human fraudsters used synthetic executive video and voice to create a false corporate identity and payment-authority context that materially induced transfers totalling about HK$200 million. The deception was human-directed; the AI-mediated representations supplied the credible false economic premise.
Synthetic senior-colleague identities and a false confidential transaction steered the Arup employee to authorise transfers without a truthful basis for that choice.

new_assessment.coverage_note: All twelve dimensions reviewed against the bounded occurrence. Official police reporting records about HK$200 million actually lost after the synthetic conference and subsequent payment instructions. Independent reporting supplies approximately US$25 million. The recorded USD equivalent is within S3. Arup says stability, operations and internal systems were unaffected. Qualitative S2 disruption and S3 livelihood/organisational-loss alternatives were separately tested; neither creates a higher band, and no insolvency or livelihood impairment is inferred. Later recovery information being incomplete does not erase the realised transfers. Relational-role and heightened-protection boundaries independently tested; no new relationship is admitted.
